title: Overstitch – Indication and outcome
summary: The overstitch procedure is an endoscopic procedure to narrow the gastrojejunostomy after Roux en Y gastric bypass, a common bariatric and metabolic operation. The procedure is performed in case of dumping symptoms (cardiovascular dysregulation with/whithout hypoglycemia) or weight regain mostly due to a wide conjunction of the stomach pouch and small intestine. To better understand and improve the outcome of the procedure, we want to analyse our own data.
conditions: dumping syndrome and weight regain after roux en y gastric bypass

interventions.name:
Patients with dumping syndrome and/or weight regain after roux en y gastric bypass. 
Changes in weight and dumping symptoms are dokumented at the time of the overstitch procedure and after 12 and 24 months. Patients are included between 2019 and 2022.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
dumping syndrome after RYGB
weight regain after RYGB
Exclusion criteria:
under age
diabetes mellitus type I
